description: Privacy and data minimization policy for logs, prompts, fixtures, evidence and exports. Consumers: pii-reviewer, compliance-privacy-reviewer, logging-reviewer, retention-policy-reviewer and the pii-audit skill. It states no legal regime; a regime exists only where the project documents one.
rules: collect and include only the fields a task needs
personal and financial values never enter prompts, logs, telemetry or evidence unless required and redacted
fixtures and evaluation sets use synthetic or consented data
exports contain only fields the requester may see
retention periods come from project documents; absence of a basis is reported as such and not invented
legal interpretation is for a human
